This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK.
**About Product Management:** As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.
Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.
**The opportunity:**
As the Staff Product Manager for OpenTelemetry Experience, you’ll own the end-to-end journey for helping people and agents instrument workloads and successfully send useful OpenTelemetry data to Grafana Cloud.
Your mission is to make Grafana Cloud the easiest and most trusted destination for OpenTelemetry workloads. You’ll reduce the uncertainty, complexity, and failure points users encounter between deciding to adopt OpenTelemetry and receiving healthy, correctly attributed, and actionable telemetry in Grafana Cloud.
Teams can instrument workloads, directly or with the help of coding agents, through OpenTelemetry SDKs, automatic instrumentation technologies such as Beyla and SDK injection, or client-side OpenTelemetry Collectors. Each path presents different decisions, deployment requirements, configuration steps, and potential failure modes. You’ll define a coherent experience that helps users choose the right approach, complete setup successfully, troubleshoot problems, and understand whether their telemetry is healthy and useful. You’ll design a future in which a growing share of instrumentation work is performed by coding agents acting on behalf of developers. This means treating agents are first-class participants in the experience and ensuring that instrumentation options, configuration requirements, errors, and validation signals are structured, discoverable, and actionable by both humans and machines.
Your scope will include:
* OpenTelemetry SDK onboarding and configuration
* Automatic instrumentation experiences, including OBI/Beyla and SDK injection
* Client-side OpenTelemetry Collector deployment and onboarding
* Collector configuration, authentication, and initial connectivity
* Guidance and machine-readable context that help people and agents choose the right instrumentation approach
* Workflows that allow coding-agents to implement, configure and verify instrumentation safely
* Troubleshooting missing, incomplete, malformed, or unhealthy telemetry
* Validation signals that allow both people and agents to confirm that telemetry is healthy, correctly attributed, and usable in Grafana Cloud
* The transition from receiving telemetry to activating the appropriate Grafana Cloud observability solution
Success does not stop when Grafana Cloud receives the first data point. Telemetry must arrive with the quality, context, and structure required to support meaningful observability outcomes. You’ll partner closely with teams responsible for experiences such as Application Observability, Kubernetes Monitoring, Infrastructure Observability, and Drilldown Apps to ensure OpenTelemetry workloads receive a first-class experience from initial setup through first value.
This is a horizontal Staff-level product leadership role spanning multiple products and engineering teams. You may not directly own every SDK, collector, instrumentation technology, or downstream application involved in the journey. You will, however, be accountable for the coherence of the overall customer experience, its success measures, and the cross-product strategy required to improve it. AI will also be part of how you work, not only what you build. You’ll be expected to use AI tools regularly to accelerate customer-research synthesis, analyze product signals, explore technical workflows, prototype experiences, develop positioning content, and test agent-led instrumentation journeys. You’ll model thoughtful, hands-on adoption of AI while applying strong judgement to its outputs.
The role is not focused on developing OpenTelemetry as an open source project in isolation. You’ll engage with and contribute to the OpenTelemetry ecosystem where appropriate, while measuring success through customer activation and outcomes in Grafana Cloud.
**What You’ll Be Doing:**
* Define the vision, strategy, and cross-product roadmap for the journey from an uninstrumented workload to healthy, useful telemetry in Grafana Cloud solutions
* Create coherent, opinionated experiences that help users choose and implement the right approach across SDK instrumentation, automatic instrumentation, and Collector-based deployment while preserving the flexibility advanced users require
* Identify and eliminate the leading causes of setup failure, abandonment, misconfiguration, and low-quality telemetry
* Establish shared experience principles, priorities, and success criteria across the product and engineering teams contributing to the OpenTelemetry journey
* Use customer research, product data, and market insight to prioritize investments and measure outcomes such as onboarding completion, time to useful telemetry, telemetry health, and workload expansion
* Partner with downstream Grafana Cloud solution teams to create a coherent transition from telemetry ingestion to meaningful product activation
* Extend beyond product delivery to how the OpenTelemetry experience is positioned and brought to market. In partnership with Product Marketing and go-to-market teams, you’ll help define the product narrative, sharpen out differentiation, and develop launches, technical content, adoption programs, and campaigns that create demand and accelerate customer activation.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Documentation, Developer Relations, Product Marketing, and go-to-market teams to deliver and communicate a differentiated OpenTelemetry experience
* Represent Grafana Labs and its customers in relevant OpenTelemetry ecosystem discussions
**What makes you a great fit:**
* 5+ years of Product Management experience, with a strong track record in developer tools, observability, infrastructure, data platforms, or another technically complex B2B product domain
* Experience leading strategy and execution across multiple engineering teams or product areas without relying on direct organizational authority
* Strong working knowledge of OpenTelemetry, including SDK instrumentation, OTLP, Collector pipelines, telemetry context, and semantic conventions
* Experience using or building instrumentation systems, agents, telemetry collectors, configuration products, or related infrastructure
* An understanding of the challenges involved in deploying and operating software across Kubernetes, virtual machines, and public cloud environments
* Experience turning complex onboarding, configuration, and troubleshooting workflows into clear and approachable product experiences
* A history of using customer research and product data to make decisions, align stakeholders, and deliver measurable outcomes
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and nontechnical stakeholders in a remote, globally distributed organization
**Bonus Points:**
* Experience contributing to or building products around the OpenTelemetry or broader open source observability ecosystem
* Experience with automatic instrumentation, eBPF, or runtime-based instrumentation
* Firsthand experience as an SRE, platform engineer, developer, or observability practitioner
* Experience building product-led onboarding, configuration-validation, or telemetry-health experiences at scale

All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.**

**Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:**
* **100% Remote, Global Culture -**As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

# Lead Java Developer/Solution Architect (6-month contract)
* Remote
* + London, England, United Kingdom
## Job description
gravity9 is recruiting Java engineers and architects for a portfolio of engagements across UK central government. These are large-scale, data-intensive modernisation programmes: replacing legacy systems that carry statutory weight, decomposing monoliths that serve millions of users, and building secure data platforms where access control and auditability are first-class architectural concerns rather than late additions.
We are hiring across two overlapping profiles — Senior Java Developer and Application / Migration Architect — and expect most people to move between programmes as engagements start and complete. Several of these are hands-on architect roles: you will own design decisions and also write production code
The kind of work
The following are representative of current and upcoming engagements. Individual roles will draw on some of this, not all of it — we are more interested in engineers who can work confidently at the intersection of Java and data than in a checklist match against any one programme.
Secure data catalogue and access-control platform
A greenfield metadata catalogue acting as a federated index over data held across independent domains, so that authorised parties can locate and retrieve data the catalogue itself never holds. The work includes designing an attribute-based access control model over attributes such as clearance, nationality, organisational unit and compartment; enforcing those policies inside the database query path rather than filtering results afterwards; application-layer encryption with externally managed keys; hybrid lexical and semantic search with access filtering applied before candidate retrieval rather than after it; and a tamper-evident audit trail that can reconstruct why a given record was returned, redacted or withheld.
Real-time decision-support data architecture
Replacing point-to-point integration across a multi-vendor estate with a microservices architecture and a common data layer, so that operational data flows in near real time instead of over days. The work includes target-state architecture and decision records, change-data-capture ingest pipelines from upstream data services, ontology and mapping-layer design across suppliers with competing data models, separation of system, reference and insight data classes including time-series, and deployment topologies spanning cloud-hosted services down to constrained edge hardware.
Legacy-to-document-model migration at national scale
Migrating hundreds of millions of records and tens of terabytes of XML out of a legacy relational platform into a sharded document store, in support of a COBOL-to-Java microservices rewrite. The work includes a configuration-driven XML-to-JSON transformation framework backed by a versioned schema registry — twenty years of history, multiple record types and continual schema and semantic drift; CDC and streaming pipelines, or a checkpointed parallel bulk-extract alternative; a field-level mapping validation and reconciliation framework robust enough to stand up to audit; a replay and failure-diagnostics harness with dead-letter routing and idempotent re-runs; and repeated dress rehearsals toward a single cutover window with no dual running.
Monolith decomposition and data-ownership migration
Breaking a distributed monolith of well over a hundred Java services sharing a handful of database clusters into domain-owned services — moving from borrowed data to owned data without reintroducing hidden coupling. The work includes bounded-context analysis to establish which domain genuinely owns which collections, in-place data remodelling ahead of any physical move, a data-access facade with feature-flagged per-request routing between old and new stores, dual-write / backfill / reconcile / read-switch cutover lifecycles with a defined rollback at every step, cluster-to-cluster streaming and live migration tooling, and automated parallel-run and diff-on-read testing.
What you will be doing
Emphasis varies by role and programme, but MongoDB is the common thread. Every one of these engagements involves modelling for it, migrating onto it, or building on top of it, and genuine depth here is what most differentiates candidates.
Architecture and design
• Produce high- and low-level designs, security and data architectures, and architecture decision records — and take them through client design authorities and formal governance gates
• Make and defend architectural trade-offs in front of both engineering and non-technical stakeholders, including client technical authorities and third-party suppliers
• Analyse real access patterns and validate target MongoDB document models against genuine throughput, query and sharding requirements before they are baselined
• Design integration boundaries in multi-vendor programmes where you own one component and must collaborate across the seams of others
Hands-on build
• Build production Java services and RESTful APIs (Spring Boot or similar), designed for integration by multiple consuming systems and documented to OpenAPI
• Design and implement MongoDB document models, aggregation pipelines, indexing and sharding strategies, and integrate them cleanly into Java service layers rather than through a leaky abstraction
• Build data pipelines: CDC and streaming ingest, transformation frameworks, checkpointed batch extract workers, and MongoDB sink configuration and tuning at terabyte scale
• Implement access control, encryption and audit within the application and data layer, including enforcement inside the MongoDB query path, rather than bolted on around it
• Write the tests: unit, integration, golden-record fixtures, parallel-run reconciliation, and load and stress harnesses that prove performance under realistic volumes
• Work across both MongoDB Atlas and Enterprise Advanced, including Kubernetes-hosted deployments, and with the migration and sync tooling around them
Data modernisation and migration
• Model relational, XML or other legacy schemas onto MongoDB document models, handling schema and semantic drift through versioned, configuration-driven mappings rather than forked code
• Design and prove cutover mechanisms — dual-write, backfill, reconcile, read-switch, rollback — for systems where a failed migration is not an acceptable outcome
• Build validation and reconciliation tooling that satisfies audit: completeness, field-level fidelity, and query-level equivalence between old and new
Security, access control and assurance
• Design and implement attribute- or role-based access control models, including enforcement at the data layer and policy administration
• Work with application-layer and field-level encryption — MongoDB client-side field level and queryable encryption, and externally managed key material
• Produce tamper-evident audit trails and observability that answer not just what happened but why
Client-facing delivery and enablement
• Work as an embedded member of a small delivery team, frequently alongside client engineers and other suppliers
• Run workshops, playbacks and sprint demonstrations; produce design documentation, integration guides and operational runbooks
• Support knowledge transfer and upskilling of client teams — on these programmes enablement is a deliverable, not an afterthought
• Use AI-assisted engineering tooling as part of normal delivery, within the constraints client security policy sets
## Job requirements
Essential
• Strong hands-on Java — building and running production services and RESTful APIs with Spring Boot or an equivalent framework
• MongoDB — solid working experience covering document modelling, querying, aggregation pipelines and indexing, and integrating MongoDB into Java application layers. Atlas and/or Enterprise Advanced
• Data-intensive systems — demonstrable experience of pipelines, migrations or integrations at meaningful scale, and sound reasoning about throughput, ordering, idempotency and failure recovery
• API design — clean, well-documented REST interfaces suitable for integration by multiple consuming systems
• Testing — genuine automated testing discipline, plus practical experience of load and stress testing against realistic volumes
• Infrastructure and deployment — Terraform or equivalent infrastructure as code, containerised deployment on Kubernetes, and AWS or a comparable cloud
• Communication — able to write clear design documentation and hold your own in a client design authority or architecture review
• UK resident, and either holding current UK SC clearance or clearly eligible to obtain it
For architect-level roles we additionally expect:
• Proven design authority on a delivery of comparable size and sensitivity, while remaining hands-on enough to prototype, pair and review code
• Experience operating inside multi-vendor or multi-supplier programmes, including holding a technical position when other suppliers hold a different one
Desirable
• UK public sector, or another regulated and security-conscious environment
• Kafka and change-data-capture tooling such as Debezium; stream processing
• Legacy modernisation patterns — strangler fig, operational data layers, dual running and phased cutover
• Domain-driven design and bounded-context analysis; monolith decomposition
• Attribute-based access control and policy-as-code frameworks (OPA, Casbin, XACML-based systems)
• Field-level or client-side encryption, key management, HSM/KMS and KMIP integration
• Search — Lucene-based or Atlas Search, vector search, hybrid retrieval and RAG patterns
• Metadata standards such as DCAT or Dublin Core; data cataloguing, data mesh and federated data architecture concepts
• Event-driven architecture and consistency patterns in distributed systems (saga, eventual consistency)
• Oracle, COBOL or other mainframe and legacy platform familiarity
• Time-series or geospatial data; deployment to constrained or edge hardware
• AI-assisted development workflows and agentic coding tools
Working context
Engagement Contract. Typically three to twelve months per programme, with a strong likelihood of rolling onto the next. Some roles begin part-time through a design phase before going full-time for build.
Clearance SC clearance is the standard requirement for these roles, and current SC will always be the fastest route onto a programme. We will consider especially strong candidates who hold BPSS only and can sponsor SC in those cases, though clearance takes roughly three months and start dates will reflect that.
Residency UK resident. All work on these programmes is delivered from the UK by UK-onshore staff.
Working model Predominantly remote with periodic onsite attendance. Locations vary by programme — expect occasional travel to client sites including London, Manchester and Leeds.
Environment Work is typically delivered through client-supplied devices or VDI, with VPN access to client environments. You should be comfortable operating within defined information-handling and access constraints, and with the pace that government security and onboarding processes set.
Team shape Small, focused, multi-disciplinary teams. On several programmes gravity9 delivers alongside partner organisations and other suppliers, and you will need to work effectively across those boundaries.
Timing These roles support a growing pipeline of central government work. Some engagements are contracted and mobilising; others are in contract negotiation with expected start dates in the coming months. We are building the bench now so that we can mobilise quickly, and clearance lead times mean early conversations are worthwhile even where a start date is not yet fixed.

You will work across a combination of **Kotlin and Java applications**, with new development primarily in Kotlin.
The role has a strong focus on:
* Large-scale data processing and transformation.
* Regulatory and client reporting.
* High-volume databases and messaging.
* Modernising legacy applications and processes.
* Improving system performance, reliability and correctness.
* Incrementally evolving complex banking systems safely.

**Kotlin | Java | SQL Server | MongoDB | Kafka | EMS | Kubernetes | OpenShift | Autosys**

Provides medical/scientific knowledge in the safety evaluation and risk management of GSK products in clinical development and/or the post-marketing setting.
Ensures scientifically sound review and interpretation of data and management of safety issues and escalates safety issues identified through the safety review process to senior management and safety governance as appropriate. * **Storytelling:** turning complex analysis into simple, compelling insights that people can understand and act on.

* **Naturally curious** and loves finding out why things happen.
* **Interested in data, technology, AI, brands, people and culture**.
* **Comfortable with numbers** but equally interested in the story behind them.
* Someone who enjoys **solving problems** and figuring things out.
* **Excited to experiment with new technology** and learn new skills.
* **Detail-oriented** and willing to question something when it doesn’t look right.
* **Keen to contribute ideas**rather than just wait to be told what to do.

* Group Projects

Havas Platform is our flagship six-month entry-level programme, primarily for underrepresented talent who otherwise face higher barriers of entry into our industry. The programme is designed to provide you with meaningful paid work experience and tailored industry training.
Everybody on the programme is part of a real team, working on real briefs, doing real work, for real clients.

CAREER DEVELOPMENT: Unlock your potential through personalised learning experiences and receiving training in the role.
REAL WORK: Develop your skills and expertise by working on role-specific activities and projects that will give you the experience you need to thrive in our industry and beyond.

NETWORK-BUILDING: Grow your professional networks and connect with industry leaders and peers.

A little bit about us Inviqa is a full-service digital agency that designs and builds exceptional digital experiences. We blend strategy, insight, design, and engineering — underpinned by best-in-class technology and agile methodologies. We have a team of 100+ researchers, designers and engineers based in both the UK and Germany. We pride ourselves on being innovative problem-solvers focused on delivering better customer and business outcomes for our clients by designing and building digital services (apps, websites, ecommerce solutions). We are immensely proud of the long-lasting client relationships we build — for clients such as Arsenal, who have been a client for the past 10 years, to Talk Mobile who we took from zero to 500,000 customers in just four years, to working with Starbucks across 28 EMEA markets. Most recently we have engaged with a prominent UK charity to transform their current website architecture and offer a more accessible online experience for their audiences. We are part of the Havas CX network which means we have access to XD and engineering teams across the globe and can bring in experts in business consultancy or customer engagement dependent on a client's needs. Our London office is based in the Havas Kings Cross Village where you can collaborate and learn from over 26 different marketing disciplines from advertising to media to PR and social. We operate a remote and hybrid working approach, giving our people the flexibility to find a good work-life balance whilst still being connected to customers and colleagues. As an agency we put people first, building brilliant things for other people. Empathy underpins everything we do, and we do our best work when we work together, taking pride in creating high quality solutions. We value openness and curiosity, which is why we never stop learning — we dedicate time and budget to supporting everyone in this goal.
**Why are we hiring for this role?**
We're experts at helping brands better connect to their customers through great digital platform experiences. We engage with businesses across a broad set of industries, including retail, travel and leisure, entertainment, luxury, pharma and not for profit sectors. We specialise in delivering innovative user-centric design and flexible technologies to address complex business and user needs, all delivered through agile methodologies.
Our clients and prospects are looking for strategic advice that helps them realise the benefits of this approach for their customers, business, and internal teams. We need a Digital Strategist who can not only ask the right questions of our clients and identify the key challenges for our prospects but also distil and translate these into business and customer benefit recommendations. Briefing and working collaboratively with teams across the agency — our strategists deliver cohesive, compelling, and thorough proposals and solutions. **Job Description | *Digital Strategist***
The Digital Strategist is a pivotal role within Inviqa. They understand the strategic agenda of the clients and prospects, help to define it where it is missing, identify opportunities, and propose solutions. They need to be commercially-minded and capable of thinking across a broad remit of people, processes, and technology, so that our recommendations are viable based on the client's goals and our understanding of internal constraints. Working across all Inviqa departments as well as integrating with partners across the broader Havas network, our strategists translate desired business outcomes into coherent recommendations that leverage great strategy, experience design and flexible technologies to deliver real business and customer benefits. The Digital Strategist will work across both new and existing business.
**Leading the agenda with existing clients.**
The Digital Strategist will perform a strategic role across client accounts. They will help shape and facilitate discoveries, driving the design and composition of workshops and interviews, leaning on subject matter experts as needed. They will be able to translate the complex into simple benefit-led recommendations that add value to the client. They will be able to engage non-technical stakeholders and ensure internal teams understand clients' business objectives so the solutions they design will achieve them. They will proactively bring new thinking and innovations to our clients, fostering deeper relationships by understanding each client's strategic agenda and making recommendations based on Inviqa's expertise and services, as well as those from the wider Havas CX network, village and our industry partners. Commercially smart, they will know how to sell 'added value' strategic support to clients.
**Crafting the strategic approach for new business proposals.**
Working with the business development team and relevant subject matter experts, the Digital Strategist helps to define the strategic story we tell in our new business engagements. Working in collaboration, they will identify the solutions we'll provide to improve client business outcomes, and the strategic approach to pitching the work. They need to have the confidence and drive to shape a strategic response, creating a compelling story and vision for our proposals. They are led by their curiosity about prospects' businesses and industries, gaining a depth of understanding about their needs, challenges and constraints, and seeking to understand competitors as well as opportunity in the broader market landscape.
This role will be part of Inviqa's Digital Strategy team, reporting into the Strategy Director, and will collaborate with colleagues across the business on client accounts.
**Candidate Profile | *Your Experience***
We are looking for a strategist with 4+ years working either in a full-service digital agency or as part of a small IT or digital consultancy. You will have experience providing strategic insight on client accounts and winning new business. Experience in a large agency is not a pre-requisite - what is important is curiosity, flexibility and a collaborative approach that helps guide our subject matter experts to deliver solutions that meet the strategic business and customer needs of our clients and prospects.
You will have the confidence needed to lead the conversations with senior stakeholders, using the benefit of your experience from a wide range of industries to demonstrate credible understanding of their business challenges. While not a technical role, we are looking for someone who has a clear understanding of how technology fits within the overall solution and the broader benefits of flexible technologies including composable architecture, even if they do not have direct experience. What is important is being able to communicate the benefits of our recommendations in a compelling way. Someone who can work with and know when to bring in a wide range of expertise based on the ask of the project from solutions architects to experience directors to business analysts, CRO experts and technical engineering leads. A team player who can bring everyone together to provide cohesive recommendations.
We're also looking for good **data and AI literacy and proactiveness** — you don't need to be technically proficient in data science or AI tools, but you should be comfortable interpreting data to support your recommendations, and genuinely curious about how AI and emerging technologies could shape client solutions or the way we work. We want someone who asks good questions and stays current, rather than someone who can build the models themselves.
A curious, flexible, and solution-focused mindset is vital. We are looking for someone who is a natural problem-solver with the ability to conceptualise innovative digital solutions for business challenges, and who has excellent written and verbal communication skills.
**Responsibilities | *The role***
* Create and deliver energising workshops during the discovery phase of a project so that we find out all we need about a client's business, so we can define a digital strategy which is both viable and feasible.
* Serve as the strategic point of reference throughout a project or engagement, ensuring the work our teams deliver is always tied back to strategic client objectives and that we can convey that narrative to our clients.
* Bring a curious, proactive approach to **data and AI** — using data and measurement to identify how best to measure the impact of our work in delivering business and customer outcomes and staying alert to how AI-enabled tools and approaches could benefit our clients or our own ways of working. Deep technical proficiency isn't expected, but genuine interest and the confidence to explore and ask the right questions is.
* Create roadmaps that provide our clients and delivery teams with a clear path to realising the future vision state, demonstrating understanding of what impacts this might have on people and processes within the clients' organisations as well as its digital ecosystem.
* Own the strategic agenda for existing clients in collaboration with client service leads.
* Support new business opportunities working hand in hand with business development, client service, technical and XD teams the senior leadership team, and other subject matter experts.
* Draft and write compelling presentations and proposals, with a clear POV, and that stand out from the crowd.
* Help clients build the business case for recommended initiatives, including materials that support internal budget requests and client-side buy-in.
* Identify new opportunities and drive innovation by using consultative selling techniques — so we add value to our clients and to our business.
* Actively engage with and build relationships with relevant village partners, helping to shape joint propositions or identify where a 'better together' approach will benefit our clients or prospects.
* Actively engage with clients bringing them thought leadership and proactive opportunities or recommendations.
* Work alongside other strategists within the agency.
* Thought Leadership in the strategic space by being up to date and curious about relevant trends — including data and AI — which will impact the ways in the demands people will make of our technology solutions.
**Benefits | Other Reasons to join.**
You'll get the agility, entrepreneurship, and sense of ownership of a small agency, with the support of a big agency network — the best of both worlds!
**We offer:**
* A diverse and supportive team at Inviqa, the digital experience agency within Havas UK
* 25 days holiday, 3 days off between Christmas and New Year, and your birthday off
* Flexibility around your working hours and patterns: work in a way that suits you
* A large degree of autonomy and progression along with support to develop your skills through our generous training budgets and the chance to attend/present at relevant conferences
* The opportunity to participate in impactful work for some amazing world-famous brands like Starbucks, Arsenal FC, TalkMobile, and many others

* Conduct site visits to support stock investigations, process reviews and training activities.

* Review automated inputs, reports and logs for accuracy and completeness.
* Maintain accurate and audit-ready stock records.

## Location

OverviewApplication
Here at Humanoid, we believe in a future where robots amplify human potential. That’s why we’ve set out on a mission to build the world’s most capable, commercially-scalable, and safe humanoid robots. We’re bringing that mission to life with HMND‐01 Alpha - our rapidly developed humanoid platform now running in real industrial pilots - and we’re growing the team to take it even further.
# About the Role
We are looking for a Senior **Low-level Control Engineer** to join our **Control Team** in London, focusing on control development and integration for our **end-effectors**.
You will design, implement and validate **actuator- and joint-level controllers** and **grasp-level behaviours** across a family of end-effector variants - parallel and multi-finger grippers, vacuum and suction tooling, and purpose-built tooling for specific customer tasks. Each variant brings different actuation, different sensing and, critically, **different transmission mechanisms**: geared direct drives, cable- and tendon-driven routings, differential and coupled linkages, and underactuated designs where few actuators must produce adaptive, compliant grasping across many degrees of freedom.
The ideal candidate has a **solid background in control theory**, strong **software engineering skills in C++**, and comfort working from real-time embedded control up through kinematics/dynamics and hardware debugging. You will work closely with mechanical and hardware engineers - early enough in the design cycle that your input shapes actuation and transmission choices rather than merely inheriting them.
# What You'll Do
**Low-Level Control Development:**
* Tune and validate actuator- and joint-space control loops (PID, feedforward, impedance/admittance, observers, state feedback) for multi-DoF end-effectors in ROS2.
* Develop grasp-level behaviours: grasp force control, compliant closing, slip detection and correction, and adaptive grasping on underactuated grippers.
* Implement safety and fault-handling mechanisms — thermal and over-current protection, stall and jam detection, grip-loss detection, safe behaviour on fault.
**Transmission Mechanisms, Modeling & System Identification:**
* Build and identify models of actuators, transmissions and mechanisms - geared, cable/tendon-driven, differential, coupled and underactuated - including compliance, friction, backlash, hysteresis, cable stretch and pretension effects.
* Own the joint-to-actuator abstraction for these mechanisms and the correct exposure of joint versus actuator state through the control stack.
* Contribute directly to transmission mechanism design: work with mechanical engineers on routing, reduction ratios, DoF coupling and underactuation strategy, bringing the controllability and observability consequences of each option into the conversation early.
**Sensor & Hardware Integration:**
* Integrate and calibrate end-effector sensing (F/T, tactile, encoders, temperature/current, vacuum feedback) with real-time acquisition across the control stack.
* Hands-on bring-up and debugging of new end-effectors, including test-stand work and vendor-supplied units.
**Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration:**
* Close the loop with mechanical/electronics engineers across sites on actuation, transmission and sensing requirements.
* Work with data collection, applications and deployment teams so end-effectors work reliably in real use.
# What We're Looking For
* Shipped real-time-safe, object-oriented C++ control software running on real hardware.
* Tuned and validated controllers on physical actuators, including sensor calibration and bring-up.
* Modelled, identified and controlled through real mechanical transmissions - gearing, cables/tendons, differentials, coupled linkages or underactuated mechanisms - and dealt with the compliance, friction and backlash they introduce.
* Worked on end-effectors or comparable multi-DoF mechanisms, including grasp control and supporting sensing.
* Debugged at the fieldbus and OS layer: e.g. EtherCAT or CAN, on an RTOS or real-time Linux.
* Strong control theory foundation (linear/nonlinear control, stability, observers, state estimation, feedback/feedforward, filtering, frequency-domain analysis) applied to multi-DoF mechanisms via Jacobians, numerical IK/FK, and URDF/Xacro.
*Nice to have:*
* BLDC motor control (commutation, current control, torque optimization).
* ros2\_control internals (hardware interfaces, controllers, controller\_manager, plugins, lifecycle nodes).
* Tendon- or cable-driven mechanisms specifically, including pretension management, routing friction and wear behaviour.
* Tactile sensing integration; vacuum and suction tooling, including multi-cup arrays and grip-loss handling.
* System identification toolchains and simulation environments (MATLAB/Simulink, MuJoCo, Isaac Sim).
# What We Offer
* Competitive equity: stock options with meaningful upside as we scale.
* 30+ paid days off, including 23 days of annual leave, all UK bank holidays, and additional company closure days (including Christmas–New Year shutdown).
* Private healthcare, including virtual and in-person care.
* Pension scheme with 8% total contribution (5% employee, 3% employer) on full earnings.
* Free daily breakfast, catered lunch, and snacks in-office.
* Work at the frontier - collaborate daily with world-class engineers, researchers, and product experts building the next generation of AI and humanoid robotics.
* Real ownership - direct access to founding leadership, meaningful input on product direction, and the ability to drive key initiatives from day one.

• Translate technical requirements into actionable plans for both customer and internal stakeholders.
• Ensure proactive communication, clear expectations, and a consistently high customer experience.
**Cross-functional Collaboration**

• Support the creation of deployment playbooks, documentation, and best practices for the Implementation & Sustaining Engineering function.
• Collaborate with Customer Success and Support to ensure smooth handoffs and ongoing operational excellence.

* Exceptional communication skills, able to engage confidently with both executives and engineers.

* Cross-functional Trust: Build strong relationships with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams.
* Sustainment Model: Define and implement a scalable sustaining engineering process that ensures uptime, quality, and continuous optimization.

CIR was born out of a determination to expose those spreading harm - online and offline - around the world, particularly in areas of violent conflict, such as Afghanistan, Myanmar, Sudan and Ukraine. team.

television market, evolving viewer behaviours and future opportunities in an
exciting, highly competitive and increasingly complex media landscape. Our work
helps the business understand how viewers engage with ITV’s content across
broadcast, VOD and SVOD, and supports key decisions across content, scheduling,
marketing, product, strategy and performance planning.
As part of a cross-functional team, you will partner with Insight Managers, Data

their challenges and help answer the “big questions”. You will use data to

decisions and supporting ITV’s wider strategic objectives.

requirements for your business area, working with the wider team to produce
high-quality analysis, dashboards, reports and recommendations. You will be

questions being asked, and communicate insight in a way that is clear, trusted

ITV is on a mission to Supercharge Streaming and Optimise Broadcast with data
and insight right at the centre of our digital transformation strategy.

should we commission? Which audiences are the most commercially attractive for
us? What should our marketing strategy be? How do we optimise our product to
improve view through rates? How do we use VOD (Video on Demand) to offset

* Creating analysis, dashboards and reports that help stakeholders understand

* Supporting proof of concept analysis for new metrics, methodologies,

* As part of a cross-functional team, developing and embedding dashboarding
solutions for business stakeholders, enabling a culture of self-service
analytics.

* Supporting forecasting and performance analysis across key business KPIs.

# **Fractional Growth & Commercial Analytics Lead**
**Location:** Remote Europe, ideally UK / Greece **Job Type:** Freelance agreement: 2 days per week initially, reducing to approximately 1 day per week once the core analytics system is established. **Reports to:** CEO
## **About Krotos**
Krotos builds creative audio software used by sound designers, filmmakers, video editors and content creators worldwide.
Our products have been used on major productions including *Game of Thrones*, *Avengers* and *The Lord of the Rings*. We are now building the next generation of AI-powered sound creation tools while growing our subscription and enterprise businesses.
We have plenty of data. Our challenge is turning it into clear, reliable commercial decisions.
That is where you come in.
## **Your Mission**
**Give Krotos one reliable commercial truth, explain why the numbers move, and identify where we should focus to grow recurring revenue.**
This is not primarily a dashboard or reporting role.
We want someone who can answer questions such as:
* Why did MRR increase or decrease?
* What is actually driving churn?
* Which acquisition channels create customers who activate and retain?
* Which product behaviours predict long-term retention?
* Where is the biggest constraint in our growth funnel?
* Is an experiment actually working?
* What should we stop, scale or investigate next?
You will work directly with the CEO and leadership team and will be expected to challenge our assumptions when the evidence does not support them.
## **The Kind of Problems You’ll Solve**
You might discover that three systems report different MRR numbers.
We expect you to investigate the underlying data, determine why they disagree and establish which number the company should trust.
You might find that a paid acquisition channel looks efficient at signup but produces customers with poor activation or retention.
We expect you to identify that before we scale it.
You might find that users who perform a particular action during their first week retain significantly better.
We expect you to quantify the opportunity and recommend what Product or Growth should do about it.
The output we value is:
**Insight → recommendation → action**
not simply analysis.
## **Your First 45 Days**
### **1. Establish One Commercial Truth**
Audit our key commercial data sources, including:
* ChartMogul
* Chargebee
* BigQuery / our data warehouse
* Mixpanel
* website analytics
* advertising platforms
* Xero
* enterprise sales data
Define the authoritative source and metric definition for each key company number.
Resolve important discrepancies or clearly explain why they exist.
### **2. Build a Simple Commercial Scoreboard**
Create a trusted view of the growth journey:
**Acquisition → Activation → Retention → Revenue**
Covering the handful of metrics leadership actually needs to run the company.
The goal is not another large dashboard.
The goal is that leadership can quickly understand:
**Are we growing? Why? What is stopping us growing faster?**
### **3. Identify the Biggest Opportunities**
Identify and prioritise the 3–5 most important commercial opportunities or problems you find.
For each one tell us:
* What is happening?
* Why do you believe it is happening?
* What is the commercial impact?
* How confident are you?
* What should we do next?
## **Ongoing Responsibilities**
You will:
* analyse acquisition, activation, retention, expansion and revenue
* connect product behaviour to commercial outcomes
* analyse cohorts and customer segments
* evaluate channel performance based on customer quality, not vanity metrics
* help Product and Growth design measurable experiments
* validate whether experiments actually worked
* identify instrumentation and tracking gaps
* work with Engineering when data pipelines need fixing
* translate complex analysis into simple commercial recommendations
You are **not a reporting service**.
We expect you to proactively identify things leadership has missed.
## **Technical Expectations**
**Strong SQL is mandatory.**
You should be comfortable independently querying and validating raw data rather than relying entirely on dashboards.
You do not need to be a data engineer, but you must be technically strong enough to investigate inconsistencies yourself and clearly specify what Engineering needs to fix.
Experience with tools such as BigQuery, Mixpanel, ChartMogul, Chargebee and similar platforms is highly desirable.
## **Who We’re Looking For**
The ideal person has likely worked as a:
* Senior Growth Analyst
* Growth Analytics Lead
* Commercial Analytics Lead
* Head of Analytics in a smaller company
Ideally within:
* SaaS
* subscription businesses
* product-led growth
* consumer / prosumer software
* digital products
We particularly value experience in businesses where the analytics team was expected to answer:
**“Why aren’t we growing faster?”**
rather than simply fulfil reporting requests.
You should be excellent at:
* commercial and SaaS metrics
* SQL
* funnel analysis
* cohort and retention analysis
* experimentation
* segmentation
* analytical reasoning
* communicating complex findings simply
* distinguishing correlation from causation
* prioritising what matters
## **What We Don’t Want**
This role is probably not right for you if your main strength is:
* building dashboards
* producing weekly reports
* completing analytics tickets
* data engineering
* presenting large amounts of data without a recommendation
We care far more about finding the important insight than analysing everything.
## **How You’ll Be Measured**
### **Outcome 1: One Commercial Truth**
Within 45 days, leadership agrees on definitions and authoritative sources for the company’s core commercial metrics.

* Identify the biggest constraint in the funnel at any given time.

* Meta
* YouTube

* Develop hooks, concepts and use cases with the creative team.
* Turn winning concepts into multiple variations.
* Build relationships with external creators and UGC partners where useful.

* churn
* are candidates for reactivation or upgrade

Legl is building the operating system for modern legal services.
We help law firms and regulated businesses replace manual, fragmented workflows with intelligent software from client onboarding and compliance to payments, risk, and reporting.

## **We Work Best When**
* **AI is the central-operating model:** not a tool or a future plan - but the way we run.
* **Decisions live with people:** you're trusted to make calls and own them.
* **Think deeply, execute quickly:** speed and rigour, not speed or rigour.
## **What You’ll Do**
Our analytics stack is Snowflake for the warehouse, dbt Core for transformation, Fivetran for ingestion, GitHub Actions for CI and scheduling, Metabase for BI, and a Snowflake Cortex semantic layer that lets colleagues and AI tools query the business in plain English. We work in Claude Code day to day, alongside the usual editor and terminal.
The analytics stack supports the whole business, so you would be working with Finance, Sales, Customer Success and Product rather than for any one of them. The goal is that those teams can answer their own questions and make decisions from data without waiting on us. What you would genuinely own is a domain, end to end: its models, its tests, its documentation, and the definitions behind its numbers. The analytics layer and the semantic layer are shared across the team, and you would contribute to both.
The domain we would want you in first is product analytics: how new customers activate, how features get adopted, and how usage develops over the life of an account. These are the questions the business asks most often and the ones our models currently answer least well, so there is a lot of room to shape how we measure them rather than inheriting someone else's definitions.
**As an Analytics Engineer at Legl, you'll:**
* **Model the warehouse**. Design and maintain dbt models, sources, tests and documentation across our layered architecture, and keep naming and structure coherent as it grows.
* **Work with Product as features ship.** Get involved early enough to know what a new feature will emit, so it lands in the models correctly the first time rather than being retrofitted once someone notices a number looks wrong.
* **Define metrics, and contribute to the semantic layer.** Get definitions agreed and codified so a KPI means the same thing in a board pack, a dashboard and an AI answer.
* **Build for self-serve.** Design models that people can actually use themselves, whether they reach them through a semantic layer or a BI tool, and retire what nobody uses.
* **Data quality and observability.** Extend our test suite, tune alerting so failures mean something, and keep the nightly pipeline honest.
* **Consolidate rather than accumulate.** Extend and reshape what exists before adding to it, and retire what is no longer load-bearing. A smaller, clearer estate is where we want to get to, and this is a role that helps take us there.
* **Governance and privacy.** We model how law firms use Legl. We do not model the personal data of the clients those firms serve, which stays inside the product and out of the warehouse. Keeping that boundary intact is a live decision every time we bring in a new source.
## **This Role Is a Great Fit If You...**
* Are an analytics engineer, BI engineer, or modelling-heavy analyst with strong SQL and data modelling fundamentals, including dimensional design, slowly changing dimensions and incremental patterns.
* Have hands-on dbt experience in a cloud warehouse, and are comfortable reviewing SQL in pull requests.
* Use AI tooling as a normal part of the job. We work in Claude Code daily, for modelling, review and investigation, and you would too. Just as important is knowing how to make that safe: somewhere a bad change is cheap, and enough verification to know a change is right before it goes near production. Speed of generation is only useful if the checking keeps up.
* Reconcile new logic against what it replaces and quantify the difference before calling it done.
* Communicate clearly with non-technical partners and enjoy turning a vague question into something measurable.

* You wait to be handed fully specified requirements, and see the job as fulfilling requests rather than solving problems.
* Are a data scientist or ML engineer. This role is modelling, quality, semantics and BI.

AI is reshaping how legal work gets done, and at Legora we're not just watching that happen — we're building it from the inside.
Our AI Enablement function exists to make sure every team at Legora can build, use, and govern AI well. The function is young, the mandate is broad, and right now it's one person. * Strong communicator with a low-ego, collaborative style.

# Avionics FPGA Engineer

### **About Lodestar**
Lodestar's mission is to develop the first "Protect and Defend" capability for high-value space assets in orbit. Our flagship product, MITHRIL, is our hardware-agnostic, AI-enabled autonomy software suite that enables us to augment any off-the-shelf spacecraft with the ability to autonomously detect, characterise, and reversibly neutralise orbital threats. By building on the proven space heritage of our best-in-class satellite-bus partners and fully integrating MITHRIL into a single unified platform, we deliver an end-to-end, autonomous in-space bodyguarding service.
### **About the Job**
We are seeking a highly motivated **Avionics FPGA Engineer** to join our multidisciplinary team developing next-generation space systems. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and validating advanced avionics architectures for autonomous platforms. This role offers the opportunity to work hands-on across the full lifecycle, from concept and simulation to hardware testing and on-orbit readiness.
---
### **What You’ll Do**
* Design, develop, and verify RTL in SystemVerilog and/or Verilog for FPGA and SoC targets.
* Bring up and integrate SerDes interfaces and memory interfaces.
* Develop testbenches and formal proofs to ensure module and system level correctness
* Conduct hardware debugging and system level testing using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, and other lab instrumentation.
* Collaborate closely with systems, avionics software and hardware teams to ensure seamless integration of RTL designs into flight systems.
* Contribute to design documentation, test plans, and the evidence needed for design reviews, and support environmental qualification and verification testing (EMC, vibration, thermal vacuum, etc.)
---
### **Qualifications**
* BEng / MEng in Electrical Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Proficiency in SystemVerilog and/or Verilog, with a solid grasp of RTL design principles.
* Hands-on experience with at least one FPGA family or ecosystem
* Familiarity with common digital interfaces and protocols (SPI, I2C, UART)
* Experience with simulation and formal verification
* Experience dealing with clock domain crossings, static timing analysis and timing closure.
* Comfort scripting for automation, ideally in Python and/or TCL.
* Hands on experience with lab test equipment including oscilloscopes, logic analysers, and power supplies.
* Clear communication and a proactive, curious approach to picking up new tools and ideas.
### **Preferred Skills & Experience**
* High speed interfaces: MIPI-CSI, QSGMII, SGMII, 10GBASE-KR, PCIe or similar.
* Memory interfaces: DDR3, DDR4, LPDDR4 or similar
* SoC design: integrating RISC-V or Arm processor subsystems, AXI/APB/AHB protocols, and embedded Linux bring-up.
* Experience with PCB design for high speed digital designs.
* Strong knowledge of verification methodologies, functional coverage, assertions and constrained random verification
* Experience with Microchip FPGAs and development tools.
* Background in space rated electronics and high reliability design practices, including radiation effects analysis, fault tolerant architectures, and qualification processes for space systems.
* Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) or other deterministic networking.
---
### **Compensation & Benefits**
* Pay Range:
+ (E1) Junior Engineer: £30,000 - £55,000 / year
+ (E2) Mid-level Engineer: £55,000 - £75,000 / year
* Meaningful equity incentives as part of our employee option pool
* 28 Days Annual Leave
* Comprehensive medical, dental & vision coverage
* Contributory pension
* **Be part of a scrappy, dynamic, multidisciplinary, collaborative crew 🏴‍☠️**
---

# Role Profile
Primary Market and AIM Regulation (“**PMAR**”) is responsible for first line primary regulatory oversight of all of LSE plc’s markets operated in its capacity as a Recognised Investment Exchange. Playing a critical role in maintaining confidence in and the integrity of those markets, PMAR’s responsibilities include: providing advice to issuers, advisers and market participants concerning rules interpretation and application; dealing with regulatory queries; real time and post event issue resolution; development of Rulebooks and associated policy and guidance and investigating suspected non-compliance and complaints.
Comprising experienced lawyers, accountants and regulators, the team manages a wide portfolio covering all key aspects of Primary market operation of AIM, the International Securities Market (“**ISM**”) and the Private Securities Market (“**PSM**”); investigative and disciplinary activity and regulatory input into LSE plc projects, products and market development.
This Senior Regulator role primarily focusses on investigative and enforcement (“**I&E**”) activity relating to potential non-compliance with the obligations and responsibilities contained in the AIM Rules for Companies and for Nominated Advisers (the “**AIM Rules**”), the ISM and PSM Rules and the Rules of the London Stock Exchange. Working as part of a specialist, multi-skilled team, the role involves proactive day-to-day individual responsibility and accountability for a broad caseload of a varying degrees of complexity, working in close partnership with more senior-level colleagues to deliver the I&E portfolio. The role may also involve supporting the real-time work of PMAR’s Operations and Guidance team, contributing to thematic and assurance work and to wider Market Regulation projects and initiatives as required.
Reporting to the Director of I&E and the Head of PMAR, the role provides a unique opportunity to develop insight, knowledge and expertise of all of LSE plc’s operated markets and involvement in all aspects of the teams work.

· Contributes to the development of protocols amd operating procedures, policy and guidance and supports adherence to operational controls and governance. · Supports and nutures relationships with other business areas and functions, external legal counsel and other regulators or law enforcement. · Assesses and responds to information and concerns raised by market participants and investors. **Eligibility and ongoing assurance work:**
Contribute to compliance and thematic reviews of nominated advisers.
**Projects and research:**
Involvement in project work, such as development of I&E frameworks for new products or markets. Undertaking research on new issues or trends as they arise and thematic work in relation to LSE plc’s Primary Markets portfolio

**Communication** - Oral and written communications are tailored to their audience’s needs;

**Excellence** - Willingly puts in the effort to ensure activities completed on time and to the quality required. Pro-active and demonstrates initiative and personal accountability for all assigned responsibilities.;

**Delivery** - Prioritises and manages a diverse and varied workload. Takes on routine tasks as necessary. Carries out work without prompting and close supervision.
**Flexibility** – open to expanding knowledge of all market offerings, becoming a cross portfolio specialist.

# Senior Product Designer – XR, Spatial UX & AI
## Description
Lucid Reality Labs is a team creating enterprise XR and AI products that make training safer, learning more effective, and complex work easier to perform. Our projects include immersive safety and skills training, simulations, digital twins, and intelligent XR experiences.
We are looking for a senior Product Designer who can raise the design quality of our products end to end: from intuitive spatial interactions and training flows to polished, premium visual experiences.
## **Your mission**
You will make complex XR products feel clear, natural, and engaging in real use not only look good in Figma.
You will lead the design of flows, interfaces, spatial interactions, feedback systems, and visual direction for products used in VR, AR, mixed reality, and 2D companion interfaces. You will work closely with product managers, Unity/XR developers, 3D artists, technical artists, and clients.
## Responsibilities
* Own product design from discovery to delivery: user journeys, wireframes, prototypes, UI, spatial interaction rules, specifications, and design QA.
* Design intuitive XR interactions for hand tracking, controllers, poke, ray, gaze, and other input methods.
* Create clear interaction states for complex tasks for example, camera tools, scanning, hazard identification, assessment, and review flows.
* Make interactions forgiving and accessible: define input tolerances, feedback, error prevention, recovery states, and clear next steps.
* Design effective tutorial and training flows, including guidance, acknowledgment of correct and incorrect actions, progress, and performance feedback.
* Create high-quality visual interfaces with strong hierarchy, readability, proportional typography and icons, contrast, depth, motion, and responsive feedback.
* Build and maintain scalable design systems for XR and 2D product interfaces.
* Improve the visual quality of experiences through thoughtful UI styling, micro-interactions, lighting and environment direction in collaboration with 3D and technical-art teams.
* Run usability testing in-headset, identify friction early, and turn insights into prioritised improvements.
* Translate client feedback and business requirements into clear design decisions and developer-ready acceptance criteria.
* Lead design reviews and raise the quality bar across a small, fast-moving multidisciplinary team.
## Requirements
* 5+ years of product-design experience, with a portfolio of high-quality shipped digital products.
* Strong experience in VR, AR, MR, games, simulations, or other spatial-computing products. This is a core requirement.
* Excellent visual-design craft: typography, layout, colour, hierarchy, motion, component design, and premium UI styling.
* Deep understanding of human-centred interaction design, especially for task-based, immersive, or hands-on workflows.
* Experience designing user feedback, system status, learning flows, error states, and success criteria.
* Advanced Figma skills, including components, auto layout, variables, prototyping, and design systems.
* Ability to make clear design decisions in ambiguous environments and explain the reasoning to clients and teammates.
* Experience collaborating closely with developers and the ability to create practical, implementation-ready specifications.
* Strong spoken and written English.
**Especially valuable**
* Experience with Unity, Unreal, or another real-time 3D environment.
* Experience designing training, safety, healthcare, industrial, manufacturing, or regulated enterprise products.
* Familiarity with hand tracking, controller interactions, spatial ergonomics, accessibility, and comfort in XR.
* Experience directing visual quality alongside 3D artists, animators, and technical artists.
* Experience with AI-powered products or intelligent assistant interfaces.
**What success looks like**
Within the first months, you will bring more structure, consistency, and quality to how we design XR products. You will help us create interfaces that are easy to understand at first use, interactions that work reliably in real conditions, training experiences that give users meaningful feedback, and visuals that feel polished, immersive, and premium.
## What We Offer
* Competitive salary
* 24 days annual vacation days
* 7 working days per year for sick leave
* Flexible working hours and ability to work remotely
* Open-minded and outside-the-box ideas embodied in life
* Award-winning and diverse team to grow together
* Friendly team and a great working environment
Join us, and together, let's make a positive impact on how we experience life!

**Role Purpose**
The Oracle Fusion HCM & Payroll Data Migration Lead is responsible for leading and executing the end-to-end data migration lifecycle for Oracle Fusion implementations. The role works closely with customer data teams, business stakeholders and HCM/Payroll functional consultants to define what data is required, how legacy data must be extracted, how it maps to Oracle Fusion, and how it is transformed, loaded, reconciled and validated.
**This is a hands-on delivery role, not a coordination-only position.** The successful candidate is expected to personally create and review migration files, perform Oracle Fusion data loads, analyse load failures, correct and reload data, develop reconciliation outputs, investigate data quality issues and provide clear explanations and recommendations to both customer and project teams.
**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Data Migration Planning and Cycle Leadership**
* Own and drive the data migration workstream across mock migrations, testing cycles, cutover rehearsals and production migration.
* Create and maintain detailed data migration plans covering extraction, mapping, transformation, file preparation, load, validation, reconciliation, defect resolution and rework.
* Define migration milestones, dependencies, entry/exit criteria, ownership and delivery checkpoints for each data object.
* Track migration progress, risks, data defects, decisions and actions, escalating issues that could impact the wider implementation plan.
* Coordinate with programme, customer, functional, technical, testing and business teams while retaining direct ownership of migration delivery.
**2. Customer Extraction Requirements and Legacy Data Analysis**
* Work closely with customer data/extraction teams to define the exact data required from the legacy system for each Oracle Fusion object.
* Translate Oracle Fusion functional and technical requirements into clear legacy extraction specifications, including required fields, selection criteria, effective dating, historical data rules, filters, defaults and valid values.
* Review customer-generated extracts for completeness, structure, data quality and fitness for migration before transformation and load activities begin.
* Analyse source data to identify duplicates, missing mandatory values, invalid dates, broken relationships, inconsistent codes, referential integrity issues and other migration risks.
* Provide actionable feedback to the customer on extraction issues and support iterative correction of source extracts.
**3. Legacy-to-Fusion Mapping and Migration Design**
* Create, maintain and mature mapping documents that establish field-level and value-level mappings between legacy systems and Oracle Fusion.
* Document source fields, Fusion target attributes, transformation rules, defaulting logic, lookup/value mappings, effective-date handling, derivation logic and business rules.
* Work with HCM and Payroll functional consultants to confirm target configuration, mandatory attributes, business rules, reference data and downstream dependencies.
* Ensure changes agreed during migration cycles, defect resolution or functional design discussions are reflected in migration mapping and transformation documentation.
* Identify gaps where legacy data cannot directly support Fusion requirements and define pragmatic transformation, cleansing or defaulting approaches with the relevant stakeholders.
**4. Hands-on Data Preparation, Transformation and Oracle Fusion Loading**
* Prepare Oracle Fusion migration templates and load-ready files from customer-provided legacy extracts.
* Perform data manipulation, transformation, enrichment, formatting and validation using SQL, Excel and other suitable analytical or data-processing tools.
* Create and execute HCM Data Loader (HDL) files and, where appropriate, HCM Spreadsheet Data Loader (HSDL) or other Oracle-supported loading mechanisms.
* Manage load sequencing and dependencies between related HCM and Payroll objects to ensure data is loaded in the correct order.
* Execute loads in Oracle Fusion, review load status and logs, identify failed records, investigate root causes, correct data or file structures and perform re-loads until agreed acceptance criteria are achieved.
* Differentiate between source-data, mapping, transformation, configuration, environment and load-mechanism issues and route or resolve them appropriately.

Threat Disruption provides expert threat intelligence and conducts scaled operations against the adversaries attacking X. We investigate and disrupt threats across the following areas:
* Platform manipulation, including coordinated networks of bots attempting to pollute the information space
* Compromises of accounts owned by high-visibility individuals and organizations
* Sensitive allegations carrying reputational, legal, or geopolitical weight, including suspected foreign-linked influence campaigns

You will play a leading role in the technical modernisation of the platform that supports our medical billing and practice management services. You will remain substantially hands-on, while also helping shape architecture, technical standards and how we move away from legacy systems over time. Your initial focus will include defining the direction of our modern platform, strengthening engineering practices, and helping deliver new capabilities across claims, medical coding, billing automation, and practice management. You will have genuine influence over technical decisions across the platform, while still spending most of your time designing and building software. What You'll Do
* Design and build reliable, secure and maintainable production software.
* Take ownership of complex technical problems from discovery through to production.
* Shape architecture, APIs, data models and service boundaries.
* Modernise existing systems while continuing to support critical business operations.
* Write high-quality production code and review critical implementations.
* Improve automated testing, reliability, security and observability.
* Mentor engineers and help establish consistent engineering standards.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering colleagues to turn business problems into practical technical solutions.
Our Technology
* PHP, Laravel, MySQL, React, TypeScript, AWS, Redis, GitHub Actions, Sentry and Playwright.
Essential Experience
* Experience operating at a senior technical level, taking ownership of complex production systems and influencing technical decisions beyond your own individual delivery.
* Strong commercial PHP experience, ideally within a Laravel environment.
* Good knowledge of relational database design and MySQL.
* Strong experience designing production systems and APIs.
* Experience mentoring engineers or providing hands-on technical leadership.
Desirable Experience
* Frontend experience using React, Vue or TypeScript.
* Modernising legacy systems while maintaining live services.
* Healthcare, billing, payments or another regulated or operationally complex environment.
* Observability tools such as Sentry, Datadog or Grafana.
* AI or LLM-assisted product capabilities in production.
* Experience building and operating production systems in AWS, Azure or another cloud platform

* Holiday Plus scheme - purchase additional leave through our HPS
* Service-based leave accrual - earn additional annual leave as your length of service grows
* Flexi start - giving you greater flexibility to balance work and personal commitments
* Corporate health insurance – company-funded cover through Irish Life

### Description
MetalBear is **remote-first**, **early-stage, and product-led**. We're building mirrord, a Kubernetes development platform that lets developers and AI coding agents run code against a live cluster before it's deployed.
The problem we solve is the wait. In any organization running microservices, checking whether a change actually works means building an image, pushing it, deploying to a shared environment, and waiting on a pipeline to tell you. That loop runs many times a day per engineer, and it's the single biggest tax on how fast an organization ships. With mirrord, the service runs wherever the work is already happening: on a laptop, in CI, or inside an agent's sandbox. Its traffic, environment variables, and file access are forwarded to and from a shared staging cluster, so the service behaves exactly as it would if it were deployed, without deploying it. Feedback arrives in seconds instead of minutes, against real APIs, real schemas, and real traffic rather than mocks or a hand-maintained local stack.
That matters more every month, because AI agents now write a large share of the code our customers ship. An agent generating code from static files is guessing at how the rest of the system behaves, and a human has to catch the guesses. mirrord gives the agent the real context to write against and a real feedback loop to verify against, so what lands in review is something a reviewer can trust.

# Quality Inspector
**ABOUT THE ROLE**
Operating at the highest levels of international motorsport, M-Sport UK delivers programmes across the FIA World Rally Championship, Rally-Raid, and a variety of global customer racing activities. We are looking to recruit a detail-focused and motivated Quality Inspector to join our Quality Control team at our Dovenby Hall headquarters.
This is an exciting opportunity for a detailed-focused quality professional to play a key role in ensuring components, assemblies and completed work meet M-Sport’s exacting quality standards. Working closely with Engineering, Production, Workshop, Stores and other departments, you will inspect parts and assemblies, identify non-conformances and support the continuous improvement of quality processes across the business.
**The role responsibilities include:**
* **Quality Inspection:**Inspect components, assemblies and completed work to ensure they meet specified drawings, tolerances and quality standards.
* **Dimensional Inspection:**Carry out accurate dimensional checks using appropriate inspection equipment and measuring tools.
* **Quality Documentation:**Maintain accurate inspection records, quality documentation and associated reports in accordance with company standards.
* **Non-Conformance:**Identify, record and communicate quality issues and non-conformances, supporting appropriate corrective actions.
* **Technical Drawings:**Interpret engineering drawings, specifications, tolerances and other technical documentation to ensure components meet requirements.
* **Cross-Departmental Collaboration:**Work closely with Engineering, Design, Production, Workshop, Stores and other departments to identify and resolve quality issues.
* **First-Off & In-Process Inspection:**Support first-off inspections and carry out in-process and final inspections where required.
* **Supplier Quality:** Assist with the inspection of incoming components and materials, identifying any issues and liaising with relevant departments as required.
* **Continuous Improvement:**Identify opportunities to improve inspection processes, quality standards and working practices.
* **Equipment & Calibration:** Ensure inspection equipment is used correctly and report any issues with measuring equipment or calibration requirements.
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR**
We’re looking for a self-motivated team player with a positive and enthusiastic attitude.
**Essential Criteria & Skills:**
* **Quality Inspection Experience:**Previous experience in a quality inspection or quality control role within manufacturing, engineering, automotive or a similar environment.
* **Attention to Detail:**Exceptional attention to detail with a methodical approach to inspection and quality control.
* **Technical Drawings:**Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications and dimensional tolerances.
* **Measuring Equipment:**Experience using precision inspection and measurement equipment.
* **Problem Solving:**Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify the root cause of quality issues.
* **Communication Skills:**Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the confidence to communicate quality issues effectively across different departments.
* **IT Literacy:**Competent using Microsoft Office applications and quality management systems.
* **Teamwork:** Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues across multiple departments whilst also working independently where required.
**Preferred Experience:**
* Experience using CMMs or other advanced inspection equipment.
* Knowledge of quality management systems.
* Relevant technical or engineering qualification.
**WHY US**
Operating a flourishing global motorsport business with state-of-the-art facilities at home and winning performances around the globe, M-Sport UK provide the engineering expertise behind an award-winning range of competition cars and has become an industry leader with success across some of the industry’s most acclaimed motorsport series.
The drive to deliver championship-winning machinery is what excites and strengthens our technical team; and our highly skilled team of Technicians and Engineers work closely through each phase of development to deliver maximum performance on the world stage.
We love what we do, and passion drives our success.
**WHAT WE OFFER**
Situated on the edge of the English Lake District National Park, M-Sport UK is unique in offering the fast-paced, high-octane, adrenaline-fuelled action expected from a career in International Motorsport mere minutes from the tranquillity of the Lakeland fells and all they have to offer in terms of recreation and wellbeing.
We also offer a range of employee benefits including: life assurance, a flexible working day, company contributed pension scheme, discounted gym membership, discount reward scheme, cycle to work scheme, company healthcare plan, long service awards, and an employee assistance programme. As well as a dedicated Work Culture Team with regular meetings, competitions and activities.
